mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% signals an accommodative monetary policy that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns when FEDFUNDS < 0.5% are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate by more than 0.2 percentage points over the past three months signals strengthening labor market conditions, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE falls > 0.2pp in 3 months, or Walk-forward Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signal robust consumer demand and business investment, driving corporate earnings growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS increase, or Walk-forward Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window for the interaction signal.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL YoY change > 2.5%), rising inflation erodes real earnings and prompts monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY change > 2.5%, or Walk-forward Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production (INDPRO) signals expanding manufacturing and business activity, which supports corporate earnings growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO rises, or Walk-forward Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly GDP growth rate above 2.0% annualized signals strong economic expansion, which boosts corporate profits and investor confidence, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when GDPC1 growth rate > 2.0% annualized, or Walk-forward Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) and decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signal a robust labor market, which increases consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when both PAYEMS grows and UNRATE falls, or Walk-forward Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window for the interaction signal.

mechanism_narrative: In monetary tightening regimes (FEDFUNDS rising by more than 0.25 percentage points over the past three months), higher interest rates reduce corporate borrowing and consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS rises > 0.25pp in 3 months, or Walk-forward Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
